# Claude environment check: raw outputs

These are the raw outputs of the Claude environment check (three model calls on trial-run material, 7 Nov 2026): a relay call, a listener call and an isolation call, each run with `claude -p` in the rebuilt relay workspace. They are kept as parser test fixtures, byte for byte and with no redaction, and they are not study data. `commands.json` records the argv and working directory of each call, and `MANIFEST.json` lists the path, size and SHA-256 of every file here except itself.
